name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the exit, but there is no hard goal clause (Existence(at_exit) or equivalent) making the exit occur. Without a hard Existence(at_exit) the machine has no FINAL_STATES, marked as a rule‑only task, which weakens the task. Add a hard Existence(at_exit) (or a hard goal that forces reaching the exit) and keep the existing ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) and Response(at_exit, holding_box) clauses.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard ChainResponse matches the requirement to pick up the box immediately after each fall, the hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures the need to be carrying the box when reaching the exit, and the hard Existence(at_exit) ensures the exit is reached. No redundant or extraneous clauses are present.

texts: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on the very next move
When reaching the exit, you must be carrying the box
